p1_findings.finding: 18,432 Acc24 context bits are implemented as flip-flops, accounting for 87.289% of all 21,116 sequential cells. Total noncombinational area is 42,569.856685 um2, or 47.911% of cell area.
p1_findings.impact: The service island is synthesizable, but its present area and clock/reset load are dominated by a register implementation that is not representative of a context SRAM macro.
p1_findings.required_followup: Build a macro adapter with explicit valid/ownership state. Do not require an SRAM macro to reset all data bits; reset or epoch-fence only validity and identity state.

p1_findings.finding: The mapped netlist has 21,116 clock loads and a common reset tree reported at 21,115 loads. DC substitutes fanout 1,000 for timing and uses an ideal clock. Worst hold slack is exactly 0.0000 ns.
p1_findings.impact: The positive 0.6872 ns setup slack is credible only for the declared ZeroWireload pre-macro point. CTS, reset-tree synthesis and routing can materially change both setup and hold.
p1_findings.required_followup: Partition/gate context clocking and replace mass data reset before any physical claim; then run macro-aware CTS/route or at minimum propagated-clock PT.

p1_findings.finding: The DC hold-only phase grows rounded cell area from 82,407.0 to 88,851.042296 um2, approximately 6,444.0 um2 or 7.820%. The final netlist contains 2,141 explicit delay cells (809.297981 um2); total buffer/inverter area is 12,586.391915 um2, 14.166% of total.
p1_findings.impact: A significant fraction of logic-only area is timing repair rather than useful service state or arithmetic, while final hold margin remains zero.
p1_findings.required_followup: Treat hold cost as an optimization target in cropped/macro variants and do not quote the present area as routed PPA.

p1_findings.finding: The design registers a 1,024-bit response payload and verifies tagged service logic, but contains zero SRAM macros. Weight-bank latency, port organization, macro output timing, banking energy and context-macro hazards remain external.
p1_findings.impact: This closes the prior free-6,144-bit response abstraction only at the RTL interface/slicing level, not at a foundry-memory implementation level.
p1_findings.required_followup: Use a finite 8-bank macro adapter and preserve request/epoch/generation identity through real response latency and backpressure.

p1_findings.finding: M218 DC is service-only. It neither instantiates M216 nor provides a native-cropped K1 area point. The premodel remains fixed-latency and the M216 4.764x number remains standalone frontend-only.
p1_findings.impact: No complete FC2 cycle speedup, composed throughput/area, or product-fair K8/K1 comparison is admitted by this DC run.
p1_findings.required_followup: Run the connected cycle miter with finite macro responses and perform matched K1/K8 plus native-cropped K1 DC sensitivity.

p1_findings.finding: DC reports nine VER-318 signed conversion/part-select warnings and sequential output inversion is enabled. Source-level VCS and independent RTL review pass, but there is no RTL-to-netlist Formality result.
p1_findings.impact: No mapped functional failure is shown, yet bit-level equivalence across synthesis transformations is not closed.
p1_findings.required_followup: Run Formality using the emitted SVF and retain full-scale signed INT8/Acc24 boundary tests before paper PPA admission.

macro_adapter: No bulk reset of context data macro; reset/flush validity and epoch ownership instead.
Finite bank ports and response latency must be executable and backpressured.
Macro response must preserve epoch, generation, slot, tag, bank mask, block and slice identity.
Count serialization and context hazards in connected cycles.
cropped_k1: Keep a scope-matched K1/K8 A/B for causal source-cap isolation.
Add native-cropped K1 only as area/energy sensitivity, not as a replacement denominator for the matched cycle ablation.
Report area composition so register/macro/buffer costs are visible.
connected_cycle_miter: Instantiate or cycle-couple M216 and M218 with finite memory responses.
Miter accepted group/request/response/context-write/result/done counts and token identity.
Replay frozen H67 payload and publish frontend stall, bank conflict, response wait and context-hazard cycles separately.

allowed: The standalone M218 tagged 16-lane slice service maps to 113,012 cells and 88,851.042 um2 at a 3 ns ideal-clock, ZeroWireload, zero-macro TSMC-28nm logic-only point.
The mapped service-only logic meets the declared setup and hold checks with +0.6872 ns and 0.0000 ns worst slack, respectively.
The current implementation explicitly prices 18,432 registered Acc24 context bits and a 1,024-bit response skid payload.
forbidden: Paper-ready PPA, routed timing, SRAM-aware area or energy
Complete FC2, complete FFN, physical or system speedup
Any M216/M218 composed cycle speedup from this service-only DC run
Any headline comparison against Prosperity, Phi or another accelerator
A claim that hold timing has physical margin beyond the exact 0.0000 ns pre-macro result
